**Product Hunt RSS 通了！**（43KB atom feed）这补上了上轮的缺口。抓它，同时试 Product Hunt 的其他端点。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 300000, "code": "
const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
 "function get(u,acc){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':acc||'application/json'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "function clean(s){return String(s||'').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim();}",
 "(async function(){",
 " const r=await get('https://www.producthunt.com/feed','application/atom+xml');",
 " console.log('status', r.status, 'len', r.body.length);",
 " const entries=r.body.split('<entry>').slice(1);",
 " console.log('ENTRIES:', entries.length);",
 " for(const e of entries){",
 " const t=/<title[^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/.exec(e);",
 " const ct=/<content[^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/content>/.exec(e);",
 " const l=/<link[^>]*href=\"([^\"]+)\"/.exec(e);",
 " const u2=/<updated>([^<]+)</.exec(e);",
 " console.log('--- '+clean(t?t[1]:'?'));",
 " if(u2) console.log(' 日期: '+u2[1].substring(0,10));",
 " if(l) console.log(' 链接: '+l[1]);",
 " console.log(' '+clean(ct?ct[1]:'').substring(0,260));",
 " }",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-ph.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-ph.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Parse Product Hunt atom feed", timeoutMs: 200000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 10000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));

  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':acc||'application/json'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
  "  }).on('error',reject);",
  "});}",
  "function clean(s){return String(s||'').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim();}",
  "(async function(){",
  "  const r=await get('https://www.producthunt.com/feed','application/atom+xml');",
  "  console.log('status', r.status, 'len', r.body.length);",
  "  const entries=r.body.split('<entry>').slice(1);",
  "  console.log('ENTRIES:', entries.length);",
  "  for(const e of entries){",
  "    const t=/<title[^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/.exec(e);",
  "    const ct=/<content[^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/content>/.exec(e);",
  "    const l=/<link[^>]*href=\"([^\"]+)\"/.exec(e);",
  "    const u2=/<updated>([^<]+)</.exec(e);",
  "    console.log('--- '+clean(t?t[1]:'?'));",
  "    if(u2) console.log('    日期: '+u2[1].substring(0,10));",
  "    if(l) console.log('    链接: '+l[1]);",
  "    console.log('    '+clean(ct?ct[1]:'').substring(0,260));",
  "  }",
  "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-ph.cjs", content: js });
